Write Analysis Results to CSV Files

Source: R/write_results.R
write_results.Rd

Write the result tables of run_pipeline() (or of a single step such as calc_fcr()) to CSV files.

write_results(
  x,
  dir = ".",
  farm = "farm",
  date = Sys.Date(),
  bom = TRUE,
  verbose = 1
)

Arguments

x

Result of run_pipeline(), or of clean_weight(), calc_adg(), calc_adfi() or calc_fcr().

dir

Folder to write to (created if needed). Default: working directory.

farm

Farm or station code used as file name prefix.

date

Date in the file names. Default: today.

bom

Write a UTF-8 byte order mark (for Excel). Default TRUE.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default).

Value

Invisibly, a data.table with table, file and rows.

Details

For a run_pipeline() result the files are:

  • fcr: one row per pig with ADG, ADFI, FCR and confidence flags;

  • by_bin: feed, gain and FCR per body weight class;

  • daily_feed: daily feed intake (recorded, corrected, imputed);

  • daily_weight: daily body weight (observed, filled and fitted);

  • weight_pigs: weight checks of every pig;

  • feed_model: coefficients of the feed intake correction model;

  • removed: removed pigs with step and reason;

  • settings: the QC settings used.

For a single step, its per_pig, daily and removed tables (and by_bin, model or summary when present) are written.

Examples

res <- run_pipeline(nedap, verbose = 0)
out <- write_results(res, dir = file.path(tempdir(), "results"), farm = "demo")
#> ✔ Wrote 9 files to /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results
out
#>           table                                                   file  rows
#>          <char>                                                 <char> <int>
#> 1:          fcr          /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_fcr_20261027.csv    29
#> 2:       by_bin       /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_by_bin_20261027.csv   258
#> 3:   daily_feed   /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_daily_feed_20261027.csv  2820
#> 4: daily_weight /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_daily_weight_20261027.csv  2605
#> 5:  weight_pigs  /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_weight_pigs_20261027.csv    30
#> 6:   feed_model   /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_feed_model_20261027.csv    14
#> 7:      summary      /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_summary_20261027.csv    14
#> 8:      removed      /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_removed_20261027.csv     1
#> 9:     settings     /tmp/RtmpaK7Dii/results/demo_settings_20261027.csv    43
unlink(file.path(tempdir(), "results"), recursive = TRUE)
